conventions: Paths are relative to the repo root. Line numbers come from review B of 2026-10-15, at commit 83b4b10; if they've moved, search for the code they point at.

Copy is shown in backticks as EN / ES / CA and is exact. Keep the quote marks the catalogs already use: “…” in English, with the full stop inside; «…» in Spanish and Catalan, with the full stop after.
Every changed string goes in app_en.arb, app_es.arb and app_ca.arb (App/docs/LOCALIZATION.md). Run `flutter gen-l10n`; never edit lib/l10n/generated/.

Owner decisions hold (.claude/ux-review/DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-15): saying a few things at once must create one task per thing ('absolutely a must'); the first-run line's spoken example names two tasks; its typed example stays one task, because a free account's typed words are parsed on the phone, which can't split them. Subtract first: no new keys, screens, settings or concepts. Don't build the open decisions (UX-615 saving by itself, UX-616 the assistant's wait, U13's two tabs).
One package, P119. Package numbering continues after P118 (2026-10-13-app, b10), so runs can't be confused.

Tests: the implementer keeps the existing tests passing and updates the ones a change rightly breaks; ux-tester writes the acceptance tests from `acceptance`. 'Widget test' and 'Unit test' name the proof expected; 'Code' lines are for the reviewer; `deviceChecks` need a phone, or, where marked, the main session with the real model.

Dates: today is Thursday 15 Oct 2026. Checks with a fixed reference use Monday 19 Oct 2026 at 10:00, whose tomorrow is Tuesday 20 Oct 2026. Widget tests that use the real today expect that day's labels (Mañana, or its `weekdayDate`).
No agent touches a phone or an emulator, and no agent calls the AI.

packages.title: The first-run line: both tasks on one day, no hour question, seen above the button
brief: Context: run 2026-10-15-changes, review B (.claude/ux-review/runs/2026-10-15-changes/review-B.md), on commit 83b4b10. On 2026-10-15 the owner decided that saying a few things at once must create one task per thing ('absolutely a must', DECISIONS.md). 83b4b10 carried that into Calendar's first-run line: its spoken example names two tasks, and its typed example stays one task, because a free account's typed words are parsed on the phone (QuickScheduleParser), which can't split them. Both stay. This package changes only the examples' words, so every task lands on one day and the phone can still date them. It also removes two decorations so the line can be seen at the largest text. No new keys, screens, settings or concepts.

UX-701 (S3). `calendarTrySaying` (App/lib/l10n/app_es.arb:222, app_en.arb:313, app_ca.arb:201; chosen at App/lib/screens/calendar_screen.dart:697-701) says «Llamar al dentista el viernes a las 10 y comprar pan mañana», with two date words. «el viernes» and «mañana» are the same day only on Thursdays. On the other six days the two tasks get two dates. Calendar lands on the earliest (`days`, App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart:2187-2194; `days.firstOrNull`, :2229), so the task said first is off screen, named only by '· también el vie, 23 oct'. When the assistant is slow (8 s) or fails, Guardar tal cual parses the words on the phone: `QuickScheduleParser.parse` returns null when it finds two date words (App/lib/services/quick_schedule_parser.dart:106-107). `localDrafts` (App/lib/services/local_capture.dart:96-99) then saves the whole sentence as one task with no date ('Añadida sin fecha').

Fix UX-701: one date word, said first, and no hour. New `calendarTrySaying`, exact: EN `Try it: tap Add a task and say “Tomorrow, call the dentist and buy bread.”` / ES `Prueba: toca Añadir tarea y di «Mañana, llamar al dentista y comprar pan».` / CA `Prova-ho: toca Afegeix una tasca i digues «Demà, trucar al dentista i comprar pa».` Both tasks then land on tomorrow and both rows light; the message reads '2 tareas añadidas', with no 'también'. Guardar tal cual gives one task, 'Llamar al dentista y comprar pan', dated tomorrow, with no question: the parser drops «Mañana» and the comma, and `localDrafts` capitalises. The person has 7 words to remember instead of 12. Don't add an hour back: «a las 10» makes the phone ask 10:00 or 22:00, and it costs a line at 2×.

UX-703 (S1). `calendarTryTyping` (app_es.arb:223, app_en.arb:317, app_ca.arb:202) shows when Añadir tarea opens typing. Its «…el viernes a las 10» always gets '¿A qué hora? 10:00 · 22:00', because the phone's parser treats a bare hour from 1 to 12 as ambiguous (quick_schedule_parser.dart:195-216), and the result can't be added until that's answered. Keep it one task, as decided. New `calendarTryTyping`, exact: EN `Try it: tap Add a task and type “Tomorrow, call the dentist.”` / ES `Prueba: toca Añadir tarea y escribe «Mañana, llamar al dentista».` / CA `Prova-ho: toca Afegeix una tasca i escriu «Demà, trucar al dentista».`

In app_en.arb, extend the two descriptions so the next edit keeps the rule (they aren't user-facing). `@calendarTrySaying`: 'Calendar's empty state while the account has no tasks or notes yet and Add a task opens the mic. The quoted example names two tasks on one day, with one date word and no hour, so both land on the same day and Save as written (the phone's parser) still dates it without a question.' `@calendarTryTyping`: 'Calendar's empty state while the account has no tasks or notes yet and Add a task opens typing. One task, because typed words are parsed on the phone, which can't split them; one date word and no hour from 1 to 12, so it's added with no question.' Each string must still name its language's `addTask` (Add a task / Añadir tarea / Afegeix una tasca). Run `flutter gen-l10n`.

UX-702 (S2). On a new account's first launch, at Android's largest font on phones 360–393 dp wide, the instruction sits partly or wholly under Añadir tarea before any scroll. Añadir tarea is `TaskActions`, Calendar's bottomNavigationBar (calendar_screen.dart:803). Above the instruction sit the week card; 'Agenda de hoy'; the line under it (`breathingRoom`, «Un momento de calma.», calendar_screen.dart:656-670); and EmptyState's 64 dp icon tile with the 16 dp gap under it (App/lib/widgets/app_components.dart:137-144). Remove the last two, in the first-run state only. No copy changes.

(a) EmptyState (app_components.dart:120-155). Make the field `final IconData? icon;` and keep the default `this.icon = Icons.event_available_outlined`, so the 15 other call sites, which don't pass `icon`, stay unchanged. When `icon` is null, build neither the tile nor the 16 dp SizedBox under it. The title, the 6 dp gap, the message, the action and the padding stay as they are.

(b) Calendar (calendar_screen.dart). Next to `total` and `hasAny` (:351-352), add `final firstRun = total == 0 && !hasAny && hadTask.valueOrNull != true;`. This is the state in which the empty state shows the instruction, or is still deciding whether to. In the header (:642-674), when `firstRun` is true, build only the title: no line under it, whatever it would hold (`breathingRoom` or `noScheduledTasks`), and no 4 dp gap. In the empty state (:690-703), pass `icon: firstRun ? null : Icons.event_available_outlined`, so the instruction has no tile and `calendarEmpty` keeps it. `rememberPrompt` ('¿Qué quieres recordar?') stays its title. Everything else looks as it does today: any day with tasks; an empty day for an account that has had a task or note (line and tile both shown); the load-error message, which keeps its tile.

Update the literal strings in App/test/calendar_feedback_test.dart at :2385, :2418, :2438, :2442, :2446 and :2450 to the new copy. Keep :2452-2455 (each string names its real button) and the 2× tests on 320×568 at :2526-2557 passing. No other test holds these strings literally; reminder_ask_sheet_test.dart reads the keys. ux-tester writes the acceptance tests.

Check your own work at 390×844, devicePixelRatio 1, view padding 24/24, with Manrope loaded (calendar_feedback_test.dart loads it in setUpAll). With both removals and the new example, the reviewer modelled the whole line above Añadir tarea at textScale 2.0 in Spanish and English, and at 1.8 in all three languages. Without the new example, it modelled the 2.0 check about 8 dp short in Spanish and English. If the line still falls short, don't remove or shrink anything else; give the measured gap in dp in your notes.

Don't touch: when the instruction shows (`hadTaskProvider`, `voiceAvailableProvider`); `calendarEmpty`; `rememberPrompt`; `breathingRoom`'s text and its use on other days; the landing and its message (`_save` in voice_task_screen.dart); Guardar tal cual; QuickScheduleParser; local_capture.dart; the typing sheet's hint `exampleTask` (UX-468); the server's prompt; DECISIONS.md (the main session updates the example it quotes).
acceptance: Unit test (UX-701, UX-703): `calendarTrySaying` reads exactly `Try it: tap Add a task and say “Tomorrow, call the dentist and buy bread.”` (EN), `Prueba: toca Añadir tarea y di «Mañana, llamar al dentista y comprar pan».` (ES) and `Prova-ho: toca Afegeix una tasca i digues «Demà, trucar al dentista i comprar pa».` (CA). `calendarTryTyping` reads exactly `Try it: tap Add a task and type “Tomorrow, call the dentist.”` (EN), `Prueba: toca Añadir tarea y escribe «Mañana, llamar al dentista».` (ES) and `Prova-ho: toca Afegeix una tasca i escriu «Demà, trucar al dentista».` (CA). Each string contains its language's `addTask`.

Unit test (UX-701): take the words between the quote marks of `calendarTrySaying` in each language (« » in ES and CA, “ ” in EN). Passed to `localDrafts` with reference Monday 19 Oct 2026 10:00 and no default day, they give exactly one draft: confirmed, with no clarification, dated Tuesday 20 Oct 2026 with no time, titled 'Llamar al dentista y comprar pan' / 'Call the dentist and buy bread' / 'Trucar al dentista i comprar pa'. With reference Friday 16 Oct 2026 10:00, the same draft is dated Saturday 17 Oct 2026.

Unit test (UX-703): the words between the quote marks of `calendarTryTyping` in each language, passed to `localDrafts` with reference Monday 19 Oct 2026 10:00 and no default day, give exactly one draft: confirmed, with no clarification (no time choices), dated Tuesday 20 Oct 2026 with no time, titled 'Llamar al dentista' / 'Call the dentist' / 'Trucar al dentista'.

Widget test (UX-701): Spanish, a new account with Pro, Calendar showing today. Save a spoken result of two tasks, 'Llamar al dentista' and 'Comprar pan', both dated tomorrow with no time, with 'Añadir 2 tareas'. Calendar selects tomorrow, both rows are lit, and the message reads '2 tareas añadidas', with 'Deshacer' and no 'también'.

Widget test (UX-702), with Manrope loaded: Calendar at 390×844, devicePixelRatio 1, view padding top 24 and bottom 24; a new account with Pro that has never had a task; today shown; not scrolled. The bottom of the `calendarTrySaying` text is at or above the top of Calendar's `TaskActions` (Añadir tarea): at textScale 1.8 in Spanish, English and Catalan, and at textScale 2.0 in Spanish and English.

Widget test (UX-702): in that first-run state, in Spanish at 1×, with Pro and again without (`calendarTryTyping`): 'Agenda de hoy' and '¿Qué quieres recordar?' show; 'Un momento de calma.' and 'No hay tareas de TaskFlow programadas' don't; Calendar's EmptyState contains no Icon.

Widget test (UX-702): an account that has had a task (its flag set), with nothing on today, in Spanish at 1×. 'Un momento de calma.' shows under 'Agenda de hoy', and the EmptyState with 'Nada previsto para este día.' shows `Icons.event_available_outlined`, as before.
Widget test (UX-702): `EmptyState` built without an `icon` argument shows `Icons.event_available_outlined`; built with `icon: null`, it shows no Icon and still shows its title and message.
Code: the U12 tests at 2× on 320×568 (calendar_feedback_test.dart:2526-2557) still pass in Spanish and Catalan, with and without Pro, and so do :2452-2455.
deviceChecks: Phone (UX-702): Android 14 or later with the font size at its largest, a phone about 390 dp wide (for example 393×851), a new account in Spanish. On first launch, without scrolling, the whole line «Prueba: toca Añadir tarea y di «Mañana, llamar al dentista y comprar pan».» sits above Añadir tarea.

Phone (UX-701, with UX-617): a new account in Spanish, on any day of the week. Tap Añadir tarea, say «Mañana, llamar al dentista y comprar pan», tap Listo, then Añadir 2 tareas. Calendar shows tomorrow with both rows lit, and the message reads «2 tareas añadidas». That the assistant returns two tasks is inferred, not yet checked.

Main session, real model (not a phone; as in 140f5cc, when the free quota allows): «Mañana, llamar al dentista y comprar pan», “Tomorrow, call the dentist and buy bread.” and «Demà, trucar al dentista i comprar pa» each come back as two tasks dated tomorrow, with no question.
